description: Face region semantic sliders [REG-03], [ID-01c] and per-region asymmetry sliders [ID-05]. Each is the weight of a named delta of the template (semantic.* / asymmetry.*). Regional PCA components [ID-01b] get entries when the statistical model provides them.

defaults.provisional: No scan data yet [ID-07]: the axis is an authored delta and the value is its weight; +-3 (usual span +-2) is the conventional span of a standardised coefficient until the statistical model recalibrates it.

parameters.description: Raises the bony bridge of the nose away from the face (a high, prominent bridge); negative values flatten it.
Widens the bridge of the nose between the eyes; negative values make it narrower and sharper.
Lengthens the nose from root to tip, moving the tip down; negative values shorten it.
Pushes the nose tip forward away from the face; negative values pull it back toward the upper lip.
Turns the nose tip upwards (upturned, more nostril visible from the front); negative values turn it down (drooping tip).
Widens the nostril wings (alae) and the base of the nose; negative values narrow them.
Moves the eyes and their sockets apart (wide-set eyes); negative values move them closer together.
Enlarges the visible eye opening between the lids; negative values make the eyes look smaller.
Raises the outer corners of the eyes relative to the inner corners (upward tilt); negative values lower them (downturned eyes).
Sets the eyes deeper into their sockets under the brow (deep-set eyes); negative values bring them forward (prominent eyes).
Raises the upper eyelid crease so more lid shows between lashes and crease; negative values lower it toward the lash line.
Lets the skin fold above the eyelid crease hang over the upper lid (hooded eyelids), covering the crease; negative values tighten it.
Makes the bony ridge above the eyes more prominent and the brows more overhanging; negative values smooth it into the forehead.
Raises the resting position of the eyebrows above the eyes; negative values lower them closer to the eyes.
Makes the forehead taller between brows and hairline; negative values make it shorter.
Slopes the forehead backwards in profile; negative values make it more upright and rounded.
Makes the upper lip fuller, showing more of its red; negative values make it thinner.
Makes the lower lip fuller, showing more of its red; negative values make it thinner.
Deepens the double curve of the upper lip line (a sharper cupid's bow); negative values flatten the upper lip line.
Widens the mouth by moving the lip corners outward; negative values make it narrower.
Pushes the lips and the area around the mouth forward in profile; negative values set them back.
Lengthens the philtrum, the groove between nose and upper lip, moving the mouth down; negative values shorten it.
Widens the lower jaw at its angles below the ears, giving a squarer lower face; negative values narrow it.
Makes the corner of the jaw below the ear sharper and more defined; negative values round it off.
Pushes the chin forward in profile (a strong chin); negative values set it back (a receding chin).
Lengthens the chin below the lower lip, making the lower face longer; negative values shorten it.
Widens the chin from a pointed to a broad, square chin; negative values make it narrower and more pointed.
Makes the cheekbones higher and more prominent; negative values flatten the midface.
Fills out the soft cheeks below the cheekbones; negative values hollow them.
Enlarges both ears; negative values make them smaller.
Turns the ears away from the head (protruding ears); negative values lay them flat against it.
Enlarges the fleshy earlobes; negative values make them small and attached.
Thickens the neck all around; negative values make it slimmer.
Lengthens the neck between jaw and shoulders; negative values shorten it.
Moves the nose along its left-right asymmetry component (a slightly deviated bridge and uneven nostrils); 0 keeps it symmetric, the sign picks the side.
Moves the eye region along its left-right asymmetry component (one eye slightly higher or more open); 0 keeps it symmetric, the sign picks the side.
Moves the mouth along its left-right asymmetry component (one corner slightly higher or the lips uneven); 0 keeps it symmetric, the sign picks the side.
Moves the jaw and chin along their left-right asymmetry component (the chin slightly off centre); 0 keeps them symmetric, the sign picks the side.
Moves the ears along their left-right asymmetry component (one ear slightly higher or larger); 0 keeps them symmetric, the sign picks the side.
Moves the brows and forehead along their left-right asymmetry component (one brow slightly higher); 0 keeps them symmetric, the sign picks the side.
Moves the cheeks along their left-right asymmetry component (one cheekbone slightly fuller); 0 keeps them symmetric, the sign picks the side.
